nagios_user.description: User account under which Nagios runs.

nagios_binary.description: Full path to the Nagios binary.

resource_file.description: Path to the resource file containing macro definitions.

status_file.description: Path to the file storing runtime status data.

queue_file.description: Path to the command queue file.

log_file.description: Path to the main Nagios log file.

log_archive_path.description: Directory where old log files are archived.

cfg_dir.description: List of directories containing object configuration files.

items.description: Path to a directory with object config files (services, hosts, etc.)

temp_file.description: Temporary file used during status updates.

lock_file.description: PID file for the Nagios daemon.

check_external_commands.description: Whether to check the external command file for commands.

command_check_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between checks of the external command file.

command_file.description: Path to the external command file.

default_contactgroup_members.description: Default members for contact groups if none specified (comma-separated).

items.description: Name of a contact group member (contact or contactgroup).

default_host_notification_period.description: Default notification time period for hosts.

default_service_notification_period.description: Default notification time period for services.

enable_event_handlers.description: Enable event handlers for hosts and services.

log_rotation_method.description: Log rotation method: 'd' = daily, 'w' = weekly, 'm' = monthly.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 0 = errors only, 1 = warnings, 2 = info, 3 = debug.

process_performance_data.description: Enable processing of performance data (e.g., for graphing).

deprecated_options.description: Path to file listing deprecated options (empty = none).

check_for_updates.description: Check for Nagios updates at startup.

bare_update_check.description: Only check for updates without installing.

max_debug_file_size.description: Max size (in MB) of debug log files.

object_cache_file.description: Path to the object cache file.

precached_object_file.description: Path to the precached object file.

retention_file.description: Path to the retention data file (state across restarts).

sleep_time.description: Amount of time (in seconds) Nagios sleeps between checks.

notification_interval.description: Interval (in minutes) between re-notification for same problem state.

passive_service_checks_default.description: Enable passive service checks by default for newly defined services.

passive_host_checks_default.description: Enable passive host checks by default for newly defined hosts.

event_broker_modules.description: List of event broker modules to load at startup.

items.description: Full path (and optional args) to a broker module (e.g., /usr/lib/nagios/plugins/objectbroker/mod_python.so)

daemon_dumps_core.description: Whether to dump core on daemon crash (for debugging).

stats_log_file.description: Path to the stats log file.

stats_availability_days.description: Number of days to retain availability data in stats file.

use_syslog.description: Log to syslog in addition to log file.

log_notifications.description: Log notifications to main log file.
